import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianEmbedding
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivGrassmannianBaseChange
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.RigidPushforwardFiberChart

/-!
# Affine residue-field detection for Grassmannian evaluation

The affine Nakayama criterion for a finite target is most useful when its
fibres are presented by the canonical residue-field points of `Spec R`.  This
file records that bridge and applies it to the Grassmannian evaluation for
curve divisors, using finite support and canonical base change of their twists.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits

namespace AlgebraicGeometry
namespace Scheme
namespace Modules

/-- An epimorphism of module sheaves on a field spectrum is surjective on
global sections, since every nonempty open is the whole spectrum. -/
theorem appTop_surjective_of_epi_over_field
    {K : Type u} [Field K] {M N : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Modules}
    (q : M ⟶ N) [hq : Epi q] :
    Function.Surjective (Hom.app q (⊤ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).Opens)).hom := by
  have he : Epi ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).ringCatSheaf).map q) :=
    @Functor.map_epi _ _ _ _ (SheafOfModules.toSheaf.{u} (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).ringCatSheaf)
      (toSheaf_preservesEpimorphisms.{u} (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).ringCatSheaf) _ _ q hq
  have hl : TopCat.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective q.mapPresheaf :=
    (Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' AddCommGrpCat.{u} _).mpr he
  rw [TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff] at hl
  letI : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) := by
    infer_instance
  intro s
  let pt : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) := IsLocalRing.closedPoint K
  obtain ⟨W, hWle, ⟨w, hw⟩, hpt⟩ := hl ⊤ s pt (by trivial)
  have hW : W = ⊤ := by
    apply top_le_iff.mp
    intro z _
    have hz : z = pt := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simpa only [hz] using hpt
  subst W
  exact ⟨w, by simpa using hw⟩

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A finite-target morphism on an affine scheme is epi when every canonical
residue-field pullback is epi.  The residue-field section map is first
transported to the quotient by the corresponding maximal ideal, then the
existing affine Nakayama criterion applies. -/
theorem epi_of_residueField_pullbacks_of_finite
    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} {M N : (Spec R).Modules}
    [M.IsQuasicoherent] [N.IsQuasicoherent]
    (q : M ⟶ N)
    [Module.Finite Γ(Spec R, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
      Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))]
    (hfib : ∀ t : Spec R, Epi ((Modules.pullback
        ((Spec R).fromSpecResidueField t)).map q)) :
    Epi q := by
  apply epi_of_appTop_baseChange_surjective_of_finite q
  intro m hm
  obtain ⟨t, hsurj, hker⟩ :=
    exists_point_appLE_fromSpecResidueField_of_isMaximal R m hm
  let e := (Spec R).fromSpecResidueField t
  letI : ((Modules.pullback e).obj M).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom e M inferInstance
  letI : ((Modules.pullback e).obj N).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom e N inferInstance
  letI aAB : Algebra Γ(Spec R, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
      Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t),
        (⊤ : (Spec ((Spec R).residueField t)).Opens)) :=
    (e.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top).hom.toAlgebra
  have hpull : Function.Surjective
      ((Hom.app ((Modules.pullback e).map q)
        (⊤ : (Spec ((Spec R).residueField t)).Opens)).hom) := by
    haveI : Epi ((Modules.pullback e).map q) := hfib t
    exact appTop_surjective_of_epi_over_field ((Modules.pullback e).map q)
  have hbc : Function.Surjective
      (((show Γ(M, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens)) →ₗ[
          Γ(Spec R, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))]
          Γ(N, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens)) from
        (q.val.app (.op (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))).hom).baseChange
          Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t),
            (⊤ : (Spec ((Spec R).residueField t)).Opens)))) := by
    exact (baseChange_surjective_iff_pullback_appTop e q).mpr hpull
  let e' : (Γ(Spec R, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens)) ⧸ m) ≃ₐ[
      Γ(Spec R, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))]
      Γ(Spec ((Spec R).residueField t),
        (⊤ : (Spec ((Spec R).residueField t)).Opens)) :=
    { (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker.symm).trans
        (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj) with
      commutes' := fun r => by
        change (RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective hsurj)
          (Ideal.quotEquivOfEq hker.symm (Ideal.Quotient.mk m r)) = _
        rw [Ideal.quotEquivOfEq_mk,
          RingHom.quotientKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk]
        rfl }
  exact surjective_baseChange_of_algEquiv _ e'.symm hbc

end Modules

namespace DivFamily

set_option maxHeartbeats 5000000 in
-- Elaborating the pullback triangle and finite-support base-change isomorphism is expensive.
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Field-test evaluation epimorphy implies epimorphy over every affine test
scheme for a curve divisor of fixed degree.  Finite support of the twisted
divisor gives finite target sections and invertible canonical base change;
Nakayama then detects the evaluation epimorphism on residue fields. -/
theorem grassmannianEval_epi_of_field_tests
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S}
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 π] [GeometricallyIntegral π] [IsProper π]
    (L : X.Modules) (hL : LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L) {d : ℕ}
    (hfield : ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K]
      (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S)
      (y : DivFamily π (Over.mk s)),
      y.HasFiberDeg d → Epi (y.grassmannianEval L))
    {R : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : Spec R ⟶ S)
    (x : DivFamily π (Over.mk f)) (hx : x.HasFiberDeg d) :
    Epi (x.grassmannianEval L) := by
  haveI : L.IsFinitePresentation := hL.isFinitePresentation
  haveI : L.IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have hpush : ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent π L
  have hsource : ((Modules.pullback f).obj
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    pullback_isQuasicoherent_hom f _ hpush
  haveI : (x.twist L).IsFinitePresentation := x.twist_isFinitePresentation L hL
  haveI : (x.twist L).IsQuasicoherent := inferInstance
  have htarget : ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π f)).obj
      (x.twist L)).IsQuasicoherent :=
    Modules.pushforward_isQuasicoherent (pullback.snd π f) (x.twist L)
  have hfinite : Module.Finite Γ(Spec R, (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens))
      Γ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π f)).obj (x.twist L),
        (⊤ : (Spec R).Opens)) :=
    module_finite_sections_pushforward_twist_of_curve L hL x
      (isAffineOpen_top (Spec R))
  refine @Modules.epi_of_residueField_pullbacks_of_finite R
    ((Modules.pullback f).obj ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L))
    ((Modules.pushforward (pullback.snd π f)).obj (x.twist L))
    hsource htarget (x.grassmannianEval L) hfinite ?_
  intro t
  let g := (Spec R).fromSpecResidueField t
  let ψ : Over.mk (g ≫ f) ⟶ Over.mk f := Over.homMk g rfl
  have hf := hfield ((Spec R).residueField t) (g ≫ f)
    (x.pullbackAlong ψ) (hx.pullbackAlong ψ)
  let e := pushforwardTwistPullbackIso_of_curve L hL x ψ
  have he : ((pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv ≫
        (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map (x.grassmannianEval L)) ≫ e.hom =
      (x.pullbackAlong ψ).grassmannianEval L := by
    simpa only [e, pushforwardTwistPullbackIso_of_curve_hom, Category.assoc] using
      grassmannianEval_pullback L x ψ
  have hfirst : Epi (((pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv ≫
        (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map (x.grassmannianEval L)) ≫ e.hom) :=
    he.symm ▸ hf
  have hsecond : Epi ((pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
      ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv ≫
        (Modules.pullback ψ.left).map (x.grassmannianEval L)) :=
    (epi_comp_iff_of_isIso _ e.hom).mp hfirst
  exact (epi_comp_iff_of_epi (pullbackTriangleIso (Over.w ψ)
    ((Modules.pushforward π).obj L)).inv _).mp hsecond

end DivFamily

end Scheme
end AlgebraicGeometry
